name: Shallow Sedge
desc: Shallow Sedge (Carex lurida): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Carex lurida is a tussock-forming flowering plant of the family Cyperaceae, the sedge family. Common names for Carex lurida include shallow sedge, sallow sedge and lurid sedge.
